definitions.NativeString: Existing embedding NativeString: scalar quoted string when exact valid scalarUTF8 else {native_bytes:"hex-v1",data:lowercasehex}. Full native arbitrary bytes, NUL, unpaired UTF16 WTF8 and invalidUTF8 retained; no new decoder, trim or normalization.
definitions.NativeFloat64: Existing embedding vector<double> grammar: JSONnumber or "NaN"|"INF"|"-INF"; finitebinary64/max_digits10/signedzero. No positive/finite/restrictedweight host guard. NaN payload/sign/signalling and decimallexeme identity remain outside semantic codec.
definitions.NativeEnum: Canonical name string, exact signed native int index, or {name:canonical|null,index:exactsignedint}; knownpairs agree; unknown requires name:null. Canonical output always{name,index}. Exact enum canonical names/index order in enums. No unknownenum host rejection.
definitions.integer: Exact JSONinteger token; int/int64/uint64/size_t native ranges; TokenInteger arbitrary signed decimalinteger with no machinewidth narrowing. No Number/MAX_SAFE/coercion/exponent/fractions. Native size_t/int widths reported.
definitions.record: Known nativefield names only; reject duplicate/unknown structurally. Missing fields retain native value-initialized/default storage. null only optional. Full canonical snapshots emit every declared field, including inheritedbase fields. Do not validate dimensions/membership/marking sign/enum semantics in codec. Array order/duplicates/empty retained. Optional null vsengagedempty retained.
definitions.maps: Native unordered/map keys are NativeString when strings. Wire ordered [{key:NativeString,value:V}] to retain arbitrary bytes; duplicatekeys rejected before native insertion. Canonical iteration sorted by actual native key ordering for determinism; map semantics claimed, not caller insertionidentity. StructuredObject uses same key/valueentry convention.
definitions.HeuristicStructuredValue: Tagged {index:0..7,value:...}:0null,1bool,2signedint64,3uint64,4NativeFloat64,5NativeString,6recursivearray,7StructuredObject entryarray. Preserve signed/unsigned/nonfinite arms, keys and nesting. No legacy untagged JSON inference.

RawEventLog.storage: All3 log/7trace/21event/10metadata fields with nested EventAttribute/NativeAttributeValue/NativeDateTime and compatibility snapshots. Existing plain/hex-v1 wrapper unchanged.

RawEventStream.schema: Direct {attributes:[complete raw EventAttribute],metadata:complete raw EventDataMetadata,events:[{fields:[complete raw EventAttribute]}]} or {native_byte_strings:"hex-v1",native_schema:"event-stream-raw-v1",value:same object with every native string hex encoded}, exact full raw schema used by discovery stream_json. All three native stored members are retained.
RawEventStream.reader: Scoped structural raw reader using existing full raw-log attribute/metadata codecs on original token spans; hex wrapper decodes each native string once. No conversion to EventLog/table or semantic validation. The legacy_view/native_state inspection envelope from existing scalar stream serializer is a different format and is not silently treated as a raw constructor.
RawEventStream.writer: Scoped canonical full raw writer always emits event-stream-raw-v1 hex-v1 wrapper; do not call serialize_embedding_workbench_stream_json and assume its scalar legacy_view/native_state envelope has this raw schema. Canonical writer has no output cap/reparse and returned raw stream File reopens with the same raw reader.

RawEventTable.storage: All7 stored fields: columns,rows,attributes,metadata,dtypes,index,categorical_dtypes; exact raw fallback wrapper retains duplicatecolumns/nonrectangular rows/missing optionalcell vs presentnull, indexrecursivevariant/categories/typed native cells. No validate() before primary.

RawLazyEventTable.schema: {table:RawEventTable,valid:bool,row_count:null|size_t}; table required, valid defaulttrue, row_count omission valid?actualrows:null. Explicitnull remains absent.
RawLazyEventTable.construction: For valid=true call the actual LazyEventTable(columns, finite restartable scanner, attributes, metadata, declared row_count, dtypes, index, categorical_dtypes) constructor. Native constructor owns columns/metadata/count checks; record its actual preparation call/throw. For valid=false use default LazyEventTable only when static descriptor state excluding rows equals default EventTable and row_count is null. Otherwise attempt the public constructor with an empty Scanner and preserve its actual native preparation exception; never silently discard requested getter state. Retained table.rows are host binding payload and original descriptor, not invented native stored rows. No scan/materialize before or after primary.
RawLazyEventTable.observability: Record actual scanner invocation count and each yielded row index, native imposedstop/throw; do not duplicate scans. Snapshot static descriptor/getters; arbitrary externalcallbacks/sideeffects/timing beyond this finite host binding remain strict boundary.

RawPetriNet.storage: Exact PetriNetLiteralStorage all9 stored members via from_literal_storage; full transitions/weights/activities/discovery_markings/transition_names, inactive source/sink storage, unknown kinds, signed arbitrarytoken magnitudes; factories structural only. No add_arc/path/export/workflow normalization.

RawProcessTree.construction: Direct ProcessTree(activities,root); full latent indexes/duplicateemptylabels/childrenofleaf/unknownops retained. Scoped byte-safe reader/writer; existing process_tree_alignment parser/writer only supports UTF/WTF8 strings, so must not reuse for arbitrarybyte fullsnapshot.
RawProcessTree.reopening: Canonical source/model artifacts use same schema; no PTML conversion.

RawPnmlDocument.construction: Aggregate direct; scoped structural fullreader/writer using records and genericNativeString/Float/Enum. Do not parse PNMLXML/export/to_petri_net_presentation as preparation, do not validate/infer stale arcs/dimensions/IDs/markings. Existing documentwriter is not sufficient: uses legacy string/net writers and derivedrawsource/rawsink. New rawnet nested state authoritative.
RawPnmlDocument.storage: Preserve optionalnull/empty map/arcs, invalidstale arc metadata, negative arbitraryTokenInteger counts/weights, unknown enum, ID/key vectors, all8 stochastictransitionfields. Native selected evaluator owns whether/how metadata is consumed.

RawPetriNetPresentation.schema: All7 fields {name:NativeString,properties:StructuredObject,places:[fullPetriPresentedPlace],transitions:[fullPetriPresentedTransition],arcs:[fullPetriPresentedArc],initial_marking:[PetriSparseMarkingEntry],final_marking:[PetriSparseMarkingEntry]}; fields exact from records.
RawPetriNetPresentation.construction: Direct aggregate, simplicityonly. Preserve nodekind enum, duplicateIDs/names/arcs/zero&signedint64 sparsemarkings/fullsignedarbitraryarcweight/negative_weight and taggedstructuredproperties. No projection/normalization or whole-model validation before primary.

definitions.nested_options_defaults: Construct parent ReplayFitnessOptions first, then patch only supplied nested alignment_options fields in that existing parent member. Same rule applies all nested option records: use actual containing native default before supplied field updates; null only on optional members.

provenance: All physical attempts retained once, including failed checks, corrections and source-first cache independence. Bodies are authoritative pooled bytes; multipart offsets and physical filename presence describe sent client wire only. The owned ContentReader response preserves parsed physical presence/order; exact raw MIME is retained independently and source-derived parser bounds remain explicit.
